scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-auction "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t auction-vue-test . && docker run --rm auction-vue-test sh -c "npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:rules"
scripts.emulators:docker: docker build -t auction-vue-test . && docker run --rm -it -p 4000:4000 -p 4400:4400 -p 8080:8080 -p 9099:9099 auction-vue-test npx firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-auction
